component.name: TaskForestI
component.summary: Eye-friendly native system monitor powered by Iced
基于 Iced 的护眼原生系统监视器

description.p: TaskForestI presents live CPU, memory, disk, network and GPU telemetry and provides process, service, startup application and login-session controls in the Iced frontend.
TaskForestI 使用 Iced 以前端展示 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络和 GPU 实时遥测，并提供进程、服务、启动应用及登录会话管理。
